tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi sbyar ba'i ngag 'don dang*/ zhar byung lus dkyil rkyang pa nyams su len tshul bcas bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs la lus dkyil dang lam dus kyi dbang sbyar ba'i ngag 'don ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ rang skad cig gis sogs nas btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig bar 'dra/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang am̐ las thod pa dang gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil bskyed pa dang*/ dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang blang ba rnams rgyas par byas mthar/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi'i he ru ka yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ 'khor dmigs gsal btab nas aṣ+ṭa ci nus bzla/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ skye mched bsrungs te bsngo smon bya/ gtso rkyang gi skabs su bsod nams tshogs bsag tshad med bzhi tsam gyis chog par bshad kyang lam dus kyi dbang dang 'brel na rgyun bshags sdom bzung nges par dgos zhes mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis gsungs pa don la gnas so// lam dus thun bzhi sogs len mkhan rnams kyis thun bar ma la dbang 'bring bsdus blang chog la thun re las mi len na rgyas pa kho na dgos pas 'dir dbang rgyas pa len rgyu byas yod pas/

'bring bsdus gnyis kyis chag med kyi go mi chod pa shes dgos so// zhes pa 'di yang gong ma'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhis don gnyer gyi ngor bris pa dge/ ༈ /yang lus dkyil rkyang pa nyams su len na/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa sogs 'dra ba las rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ gnyis su med par thim pa'i sogs kyis lus dkyil bskyed/ lam dus kyi dbang blang ba sogs dkyus bzhin rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs gong gtso rkyang dang 'dra/ de nas spro na aṣ+ṭa cung zhig bzla/ bsngo smon ji ltar rigs par bya/ 'di ni rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan dang bstun te ngag dbang legs grub kyis bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
